description: Trash, restore or permanently delete the user's own recipes. delete moves to trash (restorable 30 days; drafts 7); delete_forever and empty_trash are irreversible. Always ask the user first, then pass confirm=true. list_trash is read-only. Blocked on read-only accounts except list_trash. Returns {deleted|restored|deleted_forever|emptied, id, note} or {trash:[...]}.

action.description: delete (to trash), restore (from trash), list_trash, delete_forever (one trashed recipe), empty_trash (all)

confirm.description: Must be true for destructive actions, only after the user agreed

id.description: Recipe id (UUID) from search_recipes or an earlier result

name: delete_recipe
title: Delete or restore recipes
